title: Daisy and the Lost Button
description: A little lamb helps a lonely mole find his missing coat button, making a new friend along the way.
character_reference: a fluffy white lamb with curly wool and pink bow tied around one ear

scenes.narration: Daisy found a shiny wooden button nestled in the clover patch, polished as smooth as honey. She wondered whose special coat it might belong to.
scenes.visual: close up of a fluffy white lamb holding a round shiny wooden button carefully in her small hooves amidst green clover leaves

scenes.narration: She trotted down the garden path and spotted a little mole sniffing the dirt with a very worried look on his face. His cozy brown coat was missing one button.
scenes.visual: medium shot of the white lamb walking toward a small furry mole who is looking down at his jacket with a sad expression

scenes.narration: Excuse me, said Daisy gently, is this your treasure? She held out the smooth wooden button in her little hoof with a warm and friendly smile.
scenes.visual: close up of the lamb offering the small wooden button toward a grateful mole who reaches out with his paws

scenes.narration: The mole gasped with joy and clapped his paws together. My favorite button! You found it! Now my winter coat is complete again.
scenes.visual: happy close up of the small mole smiling brightly while holding the wooden button close to his chest

scenes.narration: To thank her, the mole shared a handful of sweet crunchy carrots from his underground pantry, and they sat together watching the sunset paint the sky.
scenes.visual: wide shot of the lamb and the mole sitting side by side on a grassy mound eating carrots against a warm orange sunset

scenes.narration: Daisy curled up in her cozy pen with a full tummy and a heart full of happiness. Helping someone else is the best way to end the day.
scenes.visual: cozy shot of the white lamb sleeping peacefully in a nest of soft straw under a blanket of twilight stars

scenes.narration: A simple act of kindness brightens everyone's world. Follow along for more bedtime stories every single day.
scenes.visual: gentle dusk scene with soft pink and orange clouds fading slowly into a peaceful starry night sky
